options.description:
Zip file with icons to use as the 'Custom' icon style.

    Each icon is named after the icon it replaces, such as 'morphe_shorts_heart.xml'.
    An icon is a vector drawable (.xml), or a white square PNG image (.png, 96x96 pixels is recommended).
    Icons missing from the file keep the 'Automatic' style.

description: Adds switches, off by default, for a message's long-press menu. Repeat sends the message again to the same chat as a new message from you. Copy photo puts a downloaded photo on the clipboard, and Message details shows the message's IDs and times, plus the file's data center and size. Quick forward lists a few recent chats to forward to in one tap.
name: Add Repeat to the message menu

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that lets phones Telegram rates as slow use its blurred chat header and panels.
name: Allow chat blur on slower phones

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that turns the screens of Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black and shows a patterned chat background's pattern over black. Message bubbles and pop-up menus keep the theme's colors. A change takes effect after Telegram restarts.
name: AMOLED black

description: Adds switches, off by default, that ask before a sticker, a GIF, a voice or video message or a call goes out. Cancel drops it.
name: Ask before sending a sticker

description: Stops Telegram sending its storage-type statistic and how long you spent on each channel post to its server. Also stops reports about Premium screen views, feature taps, accepts and purchase failures. Messages and calls work as before.
name: Disable analytics

description: Stops automatic call debug reports and log-file uploads requested by Telegram's server.
name: Disable call debug upload

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that stops a sideways swipe on a chat in the chat list from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read. A swipe set to change folders still does. Long-press keeps every action.
name: Disable chat swipe actions

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that stops reactions from a double tap in chats and the reaction-settings preview. Scrolling, taps, selection and explicit reaction menus keep their usual behavior.
name: Disable double-tap reactions

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that stops Telegram fetching link previews for messages you haven't sent yet, in chats, the share sheet, polls, story links and bot shares. Sent messages still get their preview.
name: Disable draft link previews

description: Adds a switch, off by default, so pulling down the chat list doesn't bring up a hidden archive. The chat list's menu opens it instead.
name: Disable pull to archive

description: Adds a switch, on by default, that stops pulling past the bottom of a channel from opening the next channel, and a second one, off by default, that does the same for the next forum topic. Scrolling and opening channels or topics directly still work.
name: Disable pull to next channel

description: Stops telegram.org's Telegram offering its own updates, which can't install over a patched build. Patch the new version in Morphe Manager instead.
name: Disable update checks

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K.
name: Exact numbers

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. Tapping the camera tile starts it.
name: Gallery camera on tap

description: Hides the sponsored messages in channels, the sponsored accounts in search and the ads in Telegram's video player. Telegram never asks for them, so none are counted as seen.
name: Hide ads

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open. Private chats and channel posts stay as they are, and nothing is deleted.
name: Hide blocked users in groups

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that hides the Your contacts on Telegram list under a short chat list, with its heading and loading rows. Chats, folders, contact sync and search keep their usual behavior.
name: Hide contacts on Telegram

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list.
name: Hide folder tab counters

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that takes the live camera tile out of the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos.
name: Hide gallery camera tile

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that hides the sticker an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. The empty chat's text, business introductions, Premium and paid-message notices, the sticker picker and sending keep their usual behavior.
name: Hide greeting stickers

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that closes the keyboard when you start scrolling through a chat.
name: Hide keyboard on scroll

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that covers the digits of your own phone number wherever Telegram shows it, like the side menu, Settings and your profile.
name: Hide phone number

description: Hides the Popular apps list in search's Apps tab and stops Telegram from asking its server for it. Apps you've opened and other search results stay.
name: Hide popular apps

description: Hides Premium, Stars, My Grams, Business and Send a Gift in Settings, profile Gifts tabs and the channel Gift button. Purchases and account controls keep their usual behavior.
name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars

description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners in the chat list. Account security notices and other suggestions remain. Nothing is dismissed for you.
name: Hide promotional banners

description: Hides similar channels and bots, including cached recommendations. Telegram doesn't ask for new recommendations while the switch is on.
name: Hide recommendations

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that starts Telegram's Hide sender's name option on each time you forward. You can still turn it off before sending.
name: Hide sender names when forwarding

description: Hides a proxy's sponsored channel from the chat list and folders. Leaves proxy settings and shared promo-data updates alone.
name: Hide sponsored proxy channel

description: Hides the chat-list story bar, avatar story rings and Post Story button, and stops fetching the story list. Profile stories and archives remain available.
name: Hide Stories

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that takes the Telegram Features row out of Settings and the Invite Friends rows out of Contacts.
name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that takes the time and read checks off stickers and big animated emoji in chats.
name: Hide time on stickers

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu, and a chat you're translating keeps its bar so you can go back to the original.
name: Hide translate bar

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that puts a Santa hat over the chat list logo and keeps Telegram's New Year snow falling all year over the chat list's top bar and chat backgrounds. Telegram's own holiday dates apply while it's off.
name: Holiday look all year

description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings. You can also long-press Telegram's launcher icon, or open Additional settings in the app on Telegram's App info page, to turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.
name: HushTelegram settings

description: Adds a switch, off by default, so a mention or a reply to you in a group or channel you've muted doesn't notify. Unmuted chats notify as before.
name: Ignore mentions in muted chats

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and shows a deleted label next to its time. Your own deletes, disappearing messages and protected chats work as usual, and turning it off keeps what's already saved.
name: Keep deleted messages

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that stops the volume keys in a chat from playing the video or round video on screen with sound, so they only change the volume.
name: Keep videos muted on volume keys

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that shows seconds in the time on each message, like 9:41:27 PM.
name: Message times with seconds

description: Opens ordinary HTTP(S) links in your browser. Telegram links, login, payment and authenticated routes keep their existing behavior.
name: Open links externally

description: Adds a switch, off by default, so a voice or video message stops when it ends instead of playing the next one.
name: Play voice messages one at a time

description: Keeps the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again, and clears its warning badge, once you've said no. The first request, the tab's own buttons and contact sync stay as they are.
name: Quiet contacts nag

description: Restores Telegram's official certificate header in Firebase Installations requests on re-signed builds. Other signature checks keep their usual behavior.
name: Repair Firebase push registration

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered.
name: Reveal spoilers
